profiles.security: existing development-v1/compatibility-v1 only; paranoid-v1 remains rejected

build: npm run build:offline-verifier -- --out NEW_DIRECTORY [--profile lean434-wasm-offline/1]; output must not already exist. Exact copied file bytes are pinned by a canonical manifest published last.
buildArchive: node pscv-verify.mjs --manifest-sha256 INDEPENDENTLY_PINNED_HASH --build-archive FILE --policy TRUSTED_LOCAL_POLICY; integrity of observed records only, never source preservation or complete tool discovery
includes: static ESM source/data closure and exact manifest
leanWasmAssets: The explicit Lean profile includes the actual pinned provider wrapper, prebuilt verifier, CJS launcher, Wasm module, prebuilt/source/toolchain manifests and Lean license. The existing provider verifies its prebuilt manifest; the packager also checks the exact copied snapshots and the launcher verifies every shipped file before replay. This is not proof of source-binary correspondence or complete source-distribution closure.
runtimeAssumptions: Trusted external Node.js 22+ runtime, launcher distribution channel and local filesystem/process execution. Authenticate the launcher separately and obtain the manifest digest independently. Self-hashing is not secure boot, a hostile-host sandbox or protection against check/import filesystem races.
sourceInventory: Build computes reviewed static ESM/literal-URL dependencies plus explicit profile assets. It rejects non-Node external imports, escape paths and unrecognized dynamic import owners. Only the exact Lean Wasm dynamic import is supplied in that profile; all other provider imports remain unshipped and selector-disabled. The source scan is not a general JavaScript security proof or a complete operating-system TCB inventory.
launcher: Only Node built-ins load before the expected manifest hash and bounded declared file hashes are checked. Paths are constrained; symlink files/ancestor directories, malformed descriptors, missing files and changed bytes fail closed. Core policies require an explicit provider list wholly contained in the selected distribution profile; omissions and unshipped selectors reject before provider construction. Existing provider-security restrictions still apply.
focusedEvidence: Both actual distributions ran from separate temporary directories with no compiler or node_modules. The minimal profile replayed a supported Wasm binary certificate, V1 lock and observed-build fixture. The Lean profile (29 files, about 2.4 MB at this checkpoint) replayed the actual closed theorem forall P : Prop, P -> P through the shipped kernel, rejected an invalid proof of the same statement, unavailable/default providers, paranoid policy and changed Wasm bytes. Lock/task metadata in these fixtures is fictional. No global compiler theorem follows.
